profile.summary: The Office on Trafficking in Persons (OTIP) is part of the Administration for Children and Families, a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. It advises the Assistant Secretary for Children and Families on federal anti-trafficking activities and develops strategies, policies and programs to prevent human trafficking and support survivors.
